note: ADR-0006 canonical relationship reducer weights. NOT permanent truth — calibrated from fixtures/telemetry in PR6. No downstream code may hardcode these numbers. Mirrors DEFAULT_RELATIONSHIP_REDUCER_CONFIG.

maturityDamping.note: damping = 1 - maxDamping * maturity * relationshipQuality01. NO conflict/hurt term (that was the positive-feedback bug).

redline.note: PR5 calibration: an ordinary explicitly targeted insult must still flow through relationship-sensitive irritated/hurt/withdrawn handling; hard-stop is reserved for stronger or amplified combined harm. repetition/priorBoundarySet remain amplifiers of present harm, never independent contributors.

recovery.note: conflictDecayScale/hurtDecayScale now cap ABSOLUTE points recoverable per turn (paired with maxSingleTurnRecovery). repairProgress does not grow when max(conflict,hurt) < repairInjuryFloor; it decays by repairDecayNoInjury instead.

warmthHomeostasis.note: warmth drifts gently toward baseline on calm turns so ordinary friendly chat does not ratchet down.

affect.note: CAPS scaled by this-turn signal magnitude, NOT floors. A neutral turn while withdrawn produces ~0.
